title: Runner: startup stage events and a startup benchmark script (PERF-3)

status.label: Reviewing findings
status.detail: A minimal literal candidate was materialized from the pinned upstream source. Its coordinated edits add a reparse-point path check inside the existing per-file error handling, so rejection records a failure and retains the snapshot. The supported case is a parent junction that remains present during validation and copy; no protection against concurrent path replacement or cross-user escalation is claimed. Earlier passing tests used broader source and do not validate this exact candidate. The focused fixture is being adapted without broadening the product patch, and no execution or author-facing proposal is established.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
